name: robots/healthcare-robotics__assistive-gym
title: Assistive Gym HumanTesting-v1 (PyBullet human arm test)
intro: Assistive Gym HumanTesting-v1 (PyBullet human arm test), adapted from healthcare-robotics/assistive-gym. It reads `observation`, `reward`, `terminated`, `truncated` and 4 more; runs `step`, `reset` and `seed`. `step`: advance the simulated world by a bounded number of fixed timesteps, optionally applying an action for each step, and return the resulting observation and terminal flags. A simulator: the market serves it with a stand-in that needs no simulator install.
